en: Black‑and‑white photo of a multi‑arch stone bridge crossing a shallow, rocky river. The bridge has three large arches with masonry piers and a metal or concrete railing with decorative panels. People are walking across the bridge and a few cars are visible beneath and beyond it. On the far bank stand mid‑20th‑century apartment or town buildings with steep, tiled roofs and dormer windows, surrounded by leafy trees. The foreground shows rocks and gentle rapids in the river, framed by overhanging branches. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.
